Nelson-Glenberg fine sandy loams, undulating (8 to 20 percent slopes) (NF).
This complex comprises undulating soils on sedimentary plains. Slopes are mainly 8 to 20 percent but range downward to 4 percent. The complex consists of 40 to 55 percent Nelson fine sandy loam, 25 to 40 percent Glenberg fine sandy loam and 10 to 15 percent Travessilla fine sandy loam. The Nelson soil is on the ridges and hills. The Travessilla soil is on the ridge tops and above any low sandstone ledges that outcrop on the hillsides. The Glenberg soil is on the footslopes of the hills and ridges and in the bottoms of the drainageways. The Nelson and Travessilla soils in this complex have profiles similar to those described for their respective series.
The surface runoff is medium, and the erosion hazard is severe.
This complex is suited to range.
(Capability Unit IVe-3 Dryland; Sandy range site 10-14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Croup 3M).
